errors.invoiceNotFound: This invoice doesn't exist on the network your wallet is connected to. Check that your wallet is on the right network, then refresh the page.
errors.wrongPayer: This invoice was issued to a different wallet. Switch to the wallet it was sent to and try again.
errors.insufficientAllowance: Chainvoice isn't approved to spend enough of this token. Approve the full amount, then pay again.
errors.senderCannotReceive: The invoice's sender can't receive this payment because their wallet rejected the transfer. Nothing was paid.
errors.tokenTakesFee: This token takes a fee on every transfer, so the sender would receive less than the invoice amount. The payment was blocked and nothing was paid.
errors.busy: The contract was still processing another payment. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.alreadyPaid: This invoice has already been paid.
errors.cancelled: The sender cancelled this invoice, so it can't be paid.
errors.amountMismatch: The amount sent doesn't match what this invoice needs. The network fee may have changed since the page loaded, so refresh the page and try again.
errors.feeMismatch: The network fee for a token invoice has to be paid in the network's native currency, and the amount sent didn't match the current fee. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.batchSettled: One or more of the selected invoices has already been paid or cancelled. Refresh the list and select again.
errors.mixedTokens: A batch can only hold invoices in the same token. Select invoices that use a single token.
errors.batchSize: That number of invoices isn't allowed in one batch. Select at least one invoice, or fewer invoices, and try again.
errors.batchAmountMismatch: The total sent for this batch doesn't match the invoices plus their network fees. The fee may have changed since the page loaded, so refresh the page and try again.
errors.insufficientFunds: Insufficient balance to complete this transaction
errors.network: Network error. Please check your connection and try again
errors.gas: Transaction failed due to gas estimation error. Please try again
errors.reverted: The network rejected this transaction without giving a reason. Check that your balance covers the payment and the network fee and that the invoice can still be paid, then try again.
errors.generic: Payment failed. Please try again or contact support

received.pendingHint: Full details have not arrived yet. The amount and addresses shown come from the blockchain.
received.unverifiedHint: The details delivered for this invoice do not match the hash the sender recorded on-chain, so they are not shown. Only the on-chain amount and addresses can be trusted.
received.mismatchHint: The sender's details for this invoice state a different {{field}} from the invoice recorded on-chain. Only the on-chain record is shown, and this invoice cannot be paid here.

sent.pendingHint: This invoice's details are not on this device. Only the chain's record of it is shown.
sent.unverifiedHint: The details stored on this device do not match the hash recorded on-chain for this invoice.
sent.mismatchHint: The details stored on this device state a different {{field}} from the invoice recorded on-chain. Only the on-chain record is shown, and the recipient cannot pay it from Chainvoice.

invoiceVerification.payBlocked: This invoice's details contradict its on-chain record, so it can't be paid here.

receivedInvoices.title: Received Invoices

importInvoice.title: Import Invoice
